internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: GEC originally began with a 10 acre site in Springfield which has grown to encompass over 60 acres of land with storage capacity for more than 750 truck loads of SYP logs. Today the Springfield site is the flagship facility of the GEC global export program and supports an additional five state-of-the-art export yards located throughout the Southeast. Combined; these six facilities have the capacity of loading more than 1,000 containers weekly for export.
